name: core
description: Shared UI + helper substrate: ResponsiveDialog/ConfirmDialog (+useConfirm), SectionErrorBoundary, useTheme, fmt/ago/dt, errData/ErrorLine/FRIENDLY. React-only, no app-root coupling — the most portable slice in the catalog.
notes: Source of truth for the shared kit that used to live in app/app/_components/{shared,responsive-dialog,error-boundary,use-theme}. Those app paths are now thin re-export barrels pointing here, so app internals kept their stable imports with zero churn. Feature slices import from @/features/core instead of the app root — that is what makes them copy-clean. ErrorLine is provider-agnostic: pass a `labels` map (byok owns PROVIDER_LABEL) for display names.
